title: The Hard Deadline
premise: Mara Marchetti has spent three years erasing herself after a botched extraction in Vienna left a colleague dead and her employer, the shadowy Office of Consular Affairs, disavowing everything. When a dying stranger she's never met leaves her an inheritance—a ledger proving the Office manufactured the Vienna incident—she becomes both asset and target overnight. Hunted by her former handler and the stranger's vengeful heirs, Mara must decide whether to sell the secret to the highest bidder or expose it and burn down the only family she has left. In the end, she chooses truth over loyalty, trading the ledger for immunity for her found family of fellow ghosts, and walks away knowing invisibility was always someone else's story about her.
about_author: Yara Delacroix is the pen name of a former diplomatic security consultant who spent a decade in cities that don't appear on org charts. She writes thrillers about people whose loyalties outlast their employers.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. A notary tracks Mara down at her cover job with news: a stranger named Elias Voss has died leaving her his apartment and a locked case. Mara has no memory of ever helping him. The emotional beat is unease—the past knocking on a door she bricked over.

chapters.title: Inventory of Ghosts
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Inside Voss's apartment she finds photos of Vienna—including one of her on the night of the incident—and a ledger coded in Office cipher. Her old handler, Renner, calls within hours, too knowing to be coincidence. Beat: dread hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Heirs Apparent
chapters.summary: Alternating POV with Nadia Voss, the dead man's estranged daughter, who arrives demanding her inheritance and suspects Mara killed him. Their hostile alliance begins. Beat: two liars recognizing each other.

chapters.title: Cipher and Debt
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Decoding the ledger with help from Tuck, a retired forger who anchors her found family, she learns the Office orchestrated Vienna to bury an embezzlement trail. Renner offers her reinstatement—for the ledger. Beat: temptation wearing a friendly face.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Nadia's POV. An Office wet team hits Tuck's shop; the family scatters to a safehouse. Nadia sees Mara protect Tuck without hesitation and starts questioning her assumptions. Beat: found family forming under fire.

chapters.title: What Vienna Cost
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Flashback braided with present: the truth of the incident, the colleague she couldn't save, why Voss owed her—he was the driver who pulled her out. Beat: grief finally given a name.

chapters.title: The Buyer
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. A foreign intelligence broker offers millions for the ledger, enough to vanish forever. Renner escalates, threatening Tuck and Nadia by name. Beat: the choice sharpening—wealth, silence, or war.

chapters.title: Ledger of Betrayals
chapters.summary: Nadia's POV. Nadia discovers her father spent years building the case against the Office as penance, and that Renner ordered his death. She brings the proof to Mara. Beat: vengeance and trust converging.

chapters.title: The Hard Deadline
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Climax: Mara trades the ledger to the broker only as bait, luring Renner into exposing himself before witnesses from three services. A brutal confrontation in the embassy that doesn't exist. Beat: loyalty tested against truth, truth winning at cost.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, closing with Nadia's. Renner falls, the family gets new names and real choices, and Mara sleeps through the night for the first time since Vienna. Beat: quiet resolution—invisibility traded for belonging.
